name: DesignApp sources
description: The Design app (vector and UI design): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/DesignApp, built on SuiteUI's SuiteWindow and EditorDetail: the window and its intents (DesignWindow, DesignIntent), the window toolbar's commands (DesignToolbarItem), the floating tool palette, the canvas (DesignArtwork with its text drawn by DesignTextArtwork, then an overlay above the page clip with the frame names in DesignFrameLabels, the selection marks and handles in DesignSelectionMarks, the marquee mark, and the tool-feedback slot DesignCanvasFeedback) and the inline text editor, the sidebar (a List of the pages and the layer tree), the Properties inspector (one layer, several layers with their shared or Mixed values, its Align and Distribute row in DesignAlignBar, its style rows in DesignInspectorStyle (Opacity, Corners, Stroke, the hint in the value column, and the frame fields, each scrub previewed on the live box), the Text section in DesignInspectorText (font family, size, weight and alignment, disabled on a layer that isn't text) and a page's size rows in DesignInspectorPage), the File, Edit (Duplicate after the system's pasteboard items, in DesignEditMenu), Page (Add, Rename and Delete Page), Object (Group, Ungroup, the Arrange and Align submenus and Distribute, in DesignObjectMenu) and View (zoom, Zoom to Selection) menus, each Design item off with its Model help as its tooltip, the open and save panels, and DesignLiveDrag, the window's live drag box: a canvas drag's samples and a scrub's values go to a copy only the canvas and the inspector's style rows draw, and land in the workspace as one step at the end.
